memory: OpenSparrow authority order is: latest explicit user instruction > AGENTS.md plus constitution > current feature spec/plan/tasks > longrun project facts > current session execution method > governance templates/runbooks > upstream codeSPEC references.
Non-trivial work in OpenSparrow must go through specs/<feature>/spec.md -> plan.md -> tasks.md before code or config changes.
longrun is subordinate project memory and workspace contract, not a feature-definition or truth-authority layer; it cannot replace specs or upgrade completion claims by itself.
Commander Mode activates only when the user explicitly says the main thread is commander or equivalent; it is never the default just because past sessions used commander language.
Implementation, review, verification, and closeout are separate roles in OpenSparrow; longrun or closeout notes may only record facts already supported by spec, code, tests, and fresh evidence.
PASS or DONE claims in OpenSparrow require fresh verification evidence; summaries, historical logs, or confidence are not acceptable substitutes.
Packet ownership is serialized: one packet has one primary writer, one file group has one owner at a time, and unclear ownership defaults back to serial execution.

OpenSparrow is the unified source-of-truth repo: platforms/ holds platform source, scripts/openclaw-usb/ holds shared install and hardening logic, ui/ holds the control surface, docs/specs/longrun/.specify are the documentation and memory skeleton, vendor/ is read-only upstream runtime, and dist/ is generated output only.
Historical directories opensparrow_win/, _push_opensparrow_win/, openclaw-usb-feishu-delivery/, and openclawtest/ are frozen snapshots or experiments and are not current truth sources.
The fixed project memory namespace is user_id opensparrow-memory with app_id opensparrow when supported, and all durable memories should carry metadata project=opensparrow.

The real F-014 is wecom-channel-integration. Passing means the bot-first long-connection mainline works with Bot ID plus Secret as the minimum real entry; callback or self-built-app enhanced chains are not the default blocking gate.

F-024 passing only means the baseline canonical contract, shared helpers, direct wording sync, and install/dashboard/read-back closure are frozen. It does not mean full E2E, Windows replay fidelity, or broader docs parity are complete.
F-025-A is only the replay parity baseline sub-battle closeout. It does not close the whole F-025 feature.
F-025-B remains blocked on Windows-specific evidence and must never be written as done or passing without fresh Windows-specific proof.

F-026 verified closeout only covers MAC-DIV-001, MAC-DIV-002, MAC-DIV-003, and MAC-DIV-006. It explicitly excludes MAC-DIV-004, MAC-DIV-005, MAC-DIV-007, and does not change F-025-B's blocked Windows status.

On the current mac direct user path, 01-开始部署.command is the canonical UI-first launcher; run-openclaw-usb.command and harden-openclaw-usb.command are handoff surfaces, not direct credential-collection entrypoints.

Current active mainline state is F-027 packaged Mac UI-first release readiness. Tonight's official scope is Mac-only UI-first release preparation; companion is not the default supported surface and Windows is out of scope.
Project communication and durable documentation should default to Chinese with explicit commands and full paths when giving operational guidance.

This project prefers commander-only collaboration, the minimum agent count needed for the task, no private ad-hoc agent spawning, and a star topology where workers report to commander instead of talking to each other.

When choosing tooling or process changes for OpenSparrow, prefer the fastest stable path with the least extra complexity and avoid self-built backends, daemons, cron jobs, vector databases, or webhook-based memory systems unless a later feature explicitly requires them.

In the current environment, mem0 CLI v0.2.3 add/import uses asynchronous background processing. For immediate verifiable writes during acceptance or migration, use the official Mem0 API with infer=false and async_mode=false, then verify with CLI search/get/list.
